audience: teams that book rides and parcel deliveries with Areye

useCases.title: Estimate a fare before booking
useCases.text: List the service zones and parcel sizes, then estimate the fare of a trip. The estimate does not book anything.

useCases.title: Book a ride or parcel delivery
useCases.text: Check the fare first, then book a ride or a parcel delivery. The booking charges the account and dispatches a driver.

useCases.title: Track trips and cancel one before pickup
useCases.text: List the trips and the trips in progress now. Cancel a trip before pickup; the wallet charge is refunded.

useCases.title: Review bulk delivery batches
useCases.text: List the bulk delivery batches, then open one to see the status of each stop.

useCases.title: Check account spend and billing
useCases.text: Read the account dashboard and the monthly billing statements.
